description.value: The present study aimed to investigate cortical thickness, cortical volume and the shape of subcortical structures in amphetamine-type stimulant users and drug-naïve controls.
The study used a naturalistic, non-randomized, cross-sectional comparison of three participant groups.

spans.text: The study was carried out in accordance with the declaration of Helsinki from 1975 and was approved by the local ethics committee.
